verses.text: Yahweh, remember David and all his affliction,
lines: Yahweh, remember David and all his affliction,

verses.text: how he swore to Yahweh, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:
lines: how he swore to Yahweh,
and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:

verses.text: “Surely I will not come into the structure of my house, nor go up into my bed;
lines: “Surely I will not come into the structure of my house,
nor go up into my bed;

verses.text: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids;
lines: I will not give sleep to my eyes,
or slumber to my eyelids;

verses.text: until I find out a place for Yahweh, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”
lines: until I find out a place for Yahweh,
a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”

verses.text: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah. We found it in the field of Jaar:
lines: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah.
We found it in the field of Jaar:

verses.text: “We will go into his dwelling place. We will worship at his footstool.
lines: “We will go into his dwelling place.
We will worship at his footstool.

verses.text: Arise, Yahweh, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength.
lines: Arise, Yahweh, into your resting place,
you, and the ark of your strength.

verses.text: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness. Let your saints shout for joy!”
lines: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness.
Let your saints shout for joy!”

verses.text: For your servant David’s sake, don’t turn away the face of your anointed one.
lines: For your servant David’s sake,
don’t turn away the face of your anointed one.

verses.text: Yahweh has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: “I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.
lines: Yahweh has sworn to David in truth.
He will not turn from it:
“I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.

verses.text: If your children will keep my covenant, my testimony that I will teach them, their children also will sit on your throne forever more.”
lines: If your children will keep my covenant,
my testimony that I will teach them,
their children also will sit on your throne forever more.”

verses.text: For Yahweh has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation.
lines: For Yahweh has chosen Zion.
He has desired it for his habitation.

verses.text: “This is my resting place forever. I will live here, for I have desired it.
lines: “This is my resting place forever.
I will live here, for I have desired it.

verses.text: I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread.
lines: I will abundantly bless her provision.
I will satisfy her poor with bread.

verses.text: I will also clothe her priests with salvation. Her saints will shout aloud for joy.
lines: I will also clothe her priests with salvation.
Her saints will shout aloud for joy.

verses.text: I will make the horn of David to bud there. I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.
lines: I will make the horn of David to bud there.
I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.

verses.text: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will shine.”
lines: I will clothe his enemies with shame,
but on himself, his crown will shine.”
